definition_en: Unstable, tense sound created by clashing pitches
example_en: The composer used dissonance to express the tension and conflict in the film scene.
example_zh: 作曲家使用不协和音来表现电影场景中的紧张与冲突。
subject: Music

definition_en: Variations in loudness and softness within a musical piece
example_en: The conductor asked the orchestra to pay closer attention to the dynamics marked in the score.
example_zh: 指挥要求乐队更加注意乐谱上标注的力度变化。
subject: Music

definition_en: Music created or modified using electronic devices and software
example_en: Electronic music producers use synthesizers and software to design completely new sounds.
example_zh: 电子音乐制作人使用合成器和软件来设计全新的声音。
subject: Music

definition_en: Capturing natural or real-world sounds for use in composition
example_en: The composer made a field recording of ocean waves and included it in her new piece.
example_zh: 作曲家对海浪声进行了田野录音，并将其用在了她的新作品中。
subject: Music

definition_en: Audio effect that adjusts tone by removing certain sound frequencies
example_en: By applying filtering, the producer removed the harsh high frequencies from the track.
example_zh: 通过应用滤波，制作人消除了音轨中刺耳的高频。
subject: Music

definition_en: Everyday or environmental sounds repurposed as musical material
example_en: The composer used the clatter of a train as a found sound in his percussion piece.
example_zh: 作曲家把火车的哐当声作为现成声音用在了他的打击乐作品中。
subject: Music

definition_en: Category of music sharing common style, form and conventions
example_en: Jazz, rock and hip-hop are three very different genres of popular music.
example_zh: 爵士乐、摇滚乐和嘻哈乐是三种截然不同的流行音乐体裁。
subject: Music

definition_en: Continuous sliding movement between two distinct pitches
example_en: The harpist played a sweeping glissando that shimmered like falling water.
example_zh: 竖琴演奏者弹奏了一段华丽的滑奏，宛如流水般闪烁。
subject: Music

definition_en: Inconclusive cadence ending on the dominant chord, sounding unfinished
example_en: The first phrase ends with a half cadence, leaving the listener expecting the music to continue.
example_zh: 第一个乐句以半终止结束，让听者期待音乐继续下去。
subject: Music

definition_en: Combination of multiple pitches sounding together
example_en: The choir sang in four-part harmony, with soprano, alto, tenor and bass voices.
example_zh: 合唱团以女高音、女中音、男高音和男低音四个声部演唱和声。
subject: Music

definition_en: Musical style focusing on atmosphere, colour and subtle sound textures
example_en: Debussy's Impressionist style creates dreamy sound pictures rather than clear melodies.
example_zh: 德彪西的印象主义风格营造出梦幻般的音响画面，而不是清晰的旋律。
subject: Music

definition_en: Measured distance in pitch between two notes
example_en: The interval between C and G is a perfect fifth.
example_zh: C 和 G 之间的音程是纯五度。
subject: Music

definition_en: Smooth, connected playing style with no gaps between notes
example_en: The flutist played the lyrical melody legato, making each note flow into the next.
example_zh: 长笛演奏者用连奏演奏这段抒情的旋律，使每个音自然地流向下一个音。
subject: Music

definition_en: Overlapping multiple audio tracks, melodies or sounds to build texture
example_en: The producer used layering to combine strings, piano and vocals into a rich final chorus.
example_zh: 制作人运用叠加手法，把弦乐、钢琴和人声合在一起，形成丰满的最后一段副歌。
subject: Music

definition_en: Repeating a short musical phrase or audio clip continuously
example_en: By looping the drum pattern, the DJ kept the dancers moving all night.
example_zh: DJ 通过循环播放鼓点节奏，让舞者整晚跳个不停。
subject: Music

definition_en: Key associated with bright, stable and uplifting tonal character
example_en: Happy birthday is usually sung in a major key, which gives it a cheerful sound.
example_zh: 生日歌通常用大调演唱，因此听起来欢快明亮。
subject: Music

definition_en: Linear sequence of single notes forming the main musical line
example_en: The melody of this song is so catchy that everyone can hum it after one listen.
example_zh: 这首歌的旋律十分上口，大家听一遍就能哼出来。
subject: Music

definition_en: Key associated with darker, softer or more sombre tonal character
example_en: The composer chose a minor key to express the sadness of the farewell scene.
example_zh: 作曲家选用小调来表现告别场景的悲伤。
subject: Music

definition_en: Short, distinctive musical phrase repeated or developed throughout a work
example_en: The four-note motif in Beethoven's Fifth Symphony appears again and again in the whole movement.
example_zh: 贝多芬《第五交响曲》中那个四音动机在整个乐章中反复出现。
subject: Music

definition_en: Early electronic music using recorded real-world sounds as raw material
example_en: In musique concrète, everyday noises such as trains and footsteps are turned into music.
example_zh: 在具体音乐中，火车声、脚步声等日常噪音被加工成音乐。
subject: Music

definition_en: Specific chromatic chord often used for dramatic harmonic colour
example_en: The sudden Neapolitan chord near the end of the piece added dramatic tension.
example_zh: 乐曲结尾处突然出现的那不勒斯和弦增添了戏剧性的张力。
subject: Music

definition_en: Brief decorative note moving stepwise away from and back to the main pitch
example_en: The singer decorated the long note with a quick neighbor tone before returning to it.
example_zh: 歌手在长音上加了一个短促的邻音作装饰，然后回到本音。
subject: Music

definition_en: Chords containing notes outside the main key of a piece
example_en: The use of non-diatonic harmony made the film score feel mysterious and unpredictable.
example_zh: 非自然音和声的使用让这段电影配乐显得神秘而难以预料。
subject: Music

definition_en: Repeating rhythmic or melodic pattern that persists throughout music
example_en: The bass guitar plays a steady ostinato that drives the whole song forward.
example_zh: 贝斯吉他弹奏着平稳的固定音型，推动整首歌向前进行。
subject: Music

definition_en: Consecutive perfect fifth intervals between two voices; a traditional voice-leading error
example_en: In strict four-part writing, students are taught to avoid parallel fifths between voices.
example_zh: 在严格的四声部写作中，学生要学会避免声部之间出现平行五度。
subject: Music

definition_en: Stepwise decorative note connecting two different harmony tones
example_en: The melody uses a passing tone to move smoothly from the third to the fifth of the chord.
example_zh: 旋律用一个经过音，从和弦的三音平滑地连接到五音。
subject: Music

definition_en: Complete musical unit, similar to a sentence in language
example_en: Each phrase of the song is four bars long, like a complete sentence.
example_zh: 这首歌的每个乐句都是四小节，就像一个完整的句子。
subject: Music

definition_en: How a performer shapes, groups and articulates musical phrases
example_en: Her sensitive phrasing made the simple melody sound deeply expressive.
example_zh: 她细腻的乐句处理让这段简单的旋律听起来极富表现力。
subject: Music

definition_en: Perceived highness or lowness of a musical note
example_en: A soprano can sing notes with a much higher pitch than a bass singer.
example_zh: 女高音能唱出比男低音高得多的音高。
subject: Music

definition_en: Digital effect that changes the pitch of recorded audio
example_en: The engineer used a pitch shift effect to make the singer's voice sound lower.
example_zh: 录音师使用音高变换效果，让歌手的声音听起来更低沉。
subject: Music

definition_en: “Amen” cadence; gentle closing progression separate from authentic cadence
example_en: The hymn ends with a plagal cadence, which is why it sounds like a soft 'Amen'.
example_zh: 这首赞美诗以变格终止结束，因此听起来像一声轻柔的'阿门'。
subject: Music

definition_en: Instrumental music composed to tell a story or describe a scene
example_en: Vivaldi's Four Seasons is a famous example of programme music describing nature.
example_zh: 维瓦尔第的《四季》是描绘自然的标题音乐的著名范例。
subject: Music

definition_en: Audio effect simulating natural acoustic space and echo
example_en: Adding reverb to the vocals made them sound as if they were recorded in a cathedral.
example_zh: 给人声加上混响后，听起来就像是在大教堂里录制的。
subject: Music

definition_en: Pattern of note lengths, beats and silences creating musical movement
example_en: The drummer kept a steady rhythm while the rest of the band improvised.
example_zh: 鼓手保持着稳定的节奏，乐队其他成员则即兴演奏。
subject: Music

definition_en: Musical era emphasizing intense emotion, expressive melody and rich harmony
example_en: Chopin's piano works are some of the most beloved pieces from the Romantic era.
example_zh: 肖邦的钢琴作品是浪漫主义时期最受喜爱的乐曲之一。
subject: Music

definition_en: Form with a main recurring theme alternating with contrasting sections
example_en: In rondo form, the main theme returns several times between different episodes.
example_zh: 在回旋曲式中，主题在不同的插段之间多次再现。
subject: Music

definition_en: Flexible, expressive stretching of tempo for emotional effect
example_en: The pianist played the nocturne with gentle rubato, stretching the tempo expressively.
example_zh: 钢琴家以轻柔的自由速度演奏夜曲，富有表现力地拉伸着节奏。
subject: Music

definition_en: Dominant chord borrowed from another key to add temporary tension
example_en: The songwriter used a secondary dominant to lead strongly into the chorus.
example_zh: 词曲作者用副属和弦有力地引向副歌。
subject: Music

definition_en: Multi-section structure: exposition, development, recapitulation
example_en: The first movement of Mozart's symphony follows the classical sonata form.
example_zh: 莫扎特交响曲的第一乐章遵循古典奏鸣曲式。
subject: Music

definition_en: Overall collection of sounds, tones and atmosphere in a piece
example_en: The composer created a dark soundscape using low drones and distant bells.
example_zh: 作曲家用低沉的持续音和遥远的钟声营造出阴暗的声音景观。
subject: Music

definition_en: Short, detached playing style with clear gaps between notes
example_en: The violinist played the passage staccato, making each note short and crisp.
example_zh: 小提琴手以断奏演奏这一段，每个音都短促而清脆。
subject: Music

definition_en: Overall organisation and arrangement of sections within a composition
example_en: The song's structure is verse, chorus, verse, chorus, bridge, chorus.
example_zh: 这首歌的结构是主歌、副歌、主歌、副歌、桥段、副歌。
subject: Music

definition_en: Non-chord tone held over from a previous chord, creating temporary tension
example_en: The suspension held over into the new chord before resolving downward.
example_zh: 延留音延续到新的和弦中，然后向下解决。
subject: Music

definition_en: Speed or pace of a piece of music
example_en: The conductor set a fast tempo for the final movement of the symphony.
example_zh: 指挥为交响曲的末乐章定下了很快的速度。
subject: Music

definition_en: Note that naturally pulls toward another more stable pitch
example_en: The leading note is a tendency tone that strongly pulls toward the tonic.
example_zh: 导音是倾向音，强烈地倾向于主音。
subject: Music

definition_en: How melody, harmony and rhythm combine to form the overall sound
example_en: The piece begins with a thin texture and gradually becomes thick and complex.
example_zh: 这首曲子以稀薄的织体开始，逐渐变得浓厚而复杂。
subject: Music

definition_en: Unique tone colour or quality of a voice or instrument
example_en: The flute and the oboe play the same note, but their timbre is quite different.
example_zh: 长笛和双簧管吹奏同一个音，但它们的音色截然不同。
subject: Music

definition_en: Organised system of pitches centred around a main home key
example_en: Most pop songs have a clear tonality, with all notes belonging to one key.
example_zh: 大多数流行歌曲都有明确的调性，所有音都属于同一个调。
subject: Music

definition_en: Rapid repetition of a single note for rhythmic or dramatic effect
example_en: The violins used tremolo to create a tense, trembling sound in the horror scene.
example_zh: 小提琴用震音在恐怖场景中制造出紧张颤抖的音响。
subject: Music

definition_en: Rapid alternation between a main note and the note directly above it
example_en: The flutist ended the solo with a brilliant trill on the high note.
example_zh: 长笛手以高音上华丽的颤音结束了独奏。
subject: Music

definition_en: See ABA Form (Ternary)
example_en: A simple ternary form has an A section, a contrasting B section, and then A returns.
example_zh: 简单的三段体包含 A 段、对比性的 B 段，然后 A 段再现。
subject: Music

definition_en: Art of moving individual melodic lines smoothly between chords
example_en: Good voice leading makes each vocal line move smoothly from chord to chord.
example_zh: 良好的声部进行使各声部在和弦之间平滑地移动。
subject: Music

definition_en: A serve that lands unreturned, scoring an immediate point
example_en: The tennis player hit an ace that her opponent could not even touch.
example_zh: 那位网球选手发出一记Ace球，对手连球都没能碰到。
subject: PHE

definition_en: Ability to move quickly and change direction with ease
example_en: Good agility helps basketball players dodge defenders and drive to the basket.
example_zh: 良好的敏捷性帮助篮球运动员甩开防守队员，直攻篮下。
subject: PHE

definition_en: A pass that directly helps a teammate score
example_en: He recorded ten assists in the match by setting up his teammates perfectly.
example_zh: 他在那场比赛中通过为队友创造绝佳机会，送出了十次助攻。
subject: PHE

definition_en: Offensive action to score against the opposing team
example_en: The coach told the team to speed up their attack in the second half.
example_zh: 教练要求全队在下半场加快进攻节奏。
subject: PHE

definition_en: The rear playing area of a court, furthest from the goal/net
example_en: The defender stayed in the backcourt to stop the long balls.
example_zh: 那名防守队员留在后场，以拦截对方的长传球。
subject: PHE

definition_en: Ability to maintain stable body position while moving or stationary
example_en: Gymnasts need excellent balance to perform on the narrow beam.
example_zh: 体操运动员需要出色的平衡能力才能在狭窄的平衡木上完成动作。
subject: PHE

definition_en: Boundary line marking the rearmost edge of a playing court
example_en: The serve bounced just inside the baseline, so it was counted as good.
example_zh: 发球刚好落在底线以内，因此被判为有效。
subject: PHE

definition_en: Defensive move to stop or redirect an opponent's shot/spike
example_en: The middle blocker jumped high to block the opponent's spike.
example_zh: 副攻手高高跃起，拦住了对方的扣球。
subject: PHE

definition_en: Training apparatus or marked area for physical drills
example_en: During fitness class, we practiced step-ups and jumps onto the box.
example_zh: 在体能课上，我们练习了踏上跳箱和跳上箱子的动作。
subject: PHE

definition_en: Relating to the heart and circulatory system; aerobic fitness
example_en: Running and swimming are great ways to improve cardiovascular fitness.
example_zh: 跑步和游泳是提高心血管耐力的好方法。
subject: PHE

definition_en: Central torso muscles that support posture and movement
example_en: Planks are an effective exercise for strengthening your core.
example_zh: 平板支撑是锻炼核心肌群的有效动作。
subject: PHE

definition_en: Defensive positioning to protect teammates or empty court areas
example_en: When the defender moved forward, her teammate dropped back to cover the space.
example_zh: 当防守队员上前时，她的队友回撤补位，守住空当。
subject: PHE

definition_en: Team actions to prevent opponents from scoring
example_en: Their strong defense kept the other team from scoring in the final quarter.
example_zh: 他们顽强的防守使对方在最后一节一分未得。
subject: PHE

definition_en: Controlling and moving the ball while walking or running
example_en: He learned to dribble the basketball with both hands.
example_zh: 他学会了用双手运球。
subject: PHE

definition_en: Hand-held weights used for strength training
example_en: She lifted light dumbbells to build strength in her arms.
example_zh: 她举起较轻的哑铃来增强手臂力量。
subject: PHE

definition_en: Quick, powerful burst of speed or force
example_en: Sprinters train for explosion so they can start the race as fast as possible.
example_zh: 短跑运动员专门训练爆发力，以便在起跑时尽可能快地冲出去。
subject: PHE

definition_en: Range of motion in joints and muscles
example_en: Stretching after exercise can improve your flexibility over time.
example_zh: 运动后拉伸可以逐渐提高你的柔韧性。
subject: PHE

definition_en: Rule violation committed during play
example_en: The referee called a foul when the defender pushed the shooter.
example_zh: 当防守队员推搡投篮者时，裁判吹罚了犯规。
subject: PHE

definition_en: Player whose main role is defending the goal
example_en: The goal keeper made an amazing save in the last minute of the game.
example_zh: 守门员在比赛最后一分钟完成了一次精彩的扑救。
subject: PHE

definition_en: Official who monitors boundary lines and related rules
example_en: The linesman raised his flag to signal that the ball had gone out of play.
example_zh: 边线裁判举旗示意球已出界。
subject: PHE

definition_en: Defensive specialist player in volleyball
example_en: The libero wore a different colored jersey and dug every difficult serve.
example_zh: 自由人穿着不同颜色的球衣，接起了每一个难接的发球。
subject: PHE

definition_en: Lower-body strength exercise stepping forward with bent knees
example_en: We did ten lunges on each leg to warm up before the run.
example_zh: 跑步前我们每条腿做了十个弓步来热身。
subject: PHE

definition_en: Muscles' ability to perform repeated movements without fatigue
example_en: Doing many push-ups with light effort builds muscular endurance.
example_zh: 以较轻负荷做大量俯卧撑可以增强肌肉耐力。
subject: PHE

definition_en: Team actions focused on attacking and scoring points
example_en: Their offense scored three goals in the first half of the match.
example_zh: 他们的进攻在比赛上半场就打进了三球。
subject: PHE

definition_en: Rule violation where a player is illegally positioned ahead of the ball
example_en: The goal was disallowed because the striker was offside.
example_zh: 由于前锋越位，这个进球被判无效。
subject: PHE

definition_en: Extra play period to decide a tied match
example_en: The game went into overtime after both teams finished with eighty points.
example_zh: 两队战成80平后，比赛进入了加时赛。
subject: PHE

chinese: 鱼跃救球（排球扑救动作）
definition_en: Low defensive diving move to save a ball
example_en: The volleyball player used a pancake to keep the ball from hitting the floor.
example_zh: 那名排球运动员用一个鱼跃救球动作，让球免于落地。
subject: PHE

definition_en: Transferring the ball from one player to a teammate
example_en: She made a quick pass to her teammate near the goal.
example_zh: 她快速把球传给了球门附近的队友。
subject: PHE

definition_en: Fixed central position or rotational movement used in team sports
example_en: After stopping his dribble, he used a pivot to turn and find an open teammate.
example_zh: 停球之后，他以中枢脚转身，找到了无人防守的队友。
subject: PHE

definition_en: Control of the ball by a player or team
example_en: Our team kept possession of the ball for most of the second half.
example_zh: 下半场大部分时间里，我们队都掌握着控球权。
subject: PHE

definition_en: Continuous exchange of shots/plays between opposing sides
example_en: The crowd cheered loudly during the long rally at the net.
example_zh: 网前长时间的来回对攻引得观众大声欢呼。
subject: PHE

definition_en: Gaining possession of the ball after a missed shot
example_en: The tall center grabbed the rebound and scored immediately.
example_zh: 高个子中锋抢到篮板球后立刻得分。
subject: PHE

chinese: 重复次数（训练中的单次动作）
definition_en: Single repeated movement in a strength or fitness exercise
example_en: Try to complete fifteen reps of squats in each set.
example_zh: 每组尽量完成十五次深蹲重复。
subject: PHE

definition_en: Group of repetitions in training; also a unit of scoring in court sports
example_en: We did three sets of push-ups, and the volleyball team won two sets in a row.
example_zh: 我们做了三组俯卧撑，而那支排球队连赢了两局。
subject: PHE

definition_en: Side boundary line of a playing court
example_en: The ball rolled over the sideline, so the other team got a throw-in.
example_zh: 球滚出了边线，因此由对方掷界外球。
subject: PHE

definition_en: Lower-body exercise bending knees to lower the torso
example_en: Squats are a basic exercise for building strong legs.
example_zh: 深蹲是锻炼腿部力量的基础动作。
subject: PHE

definition_en: Physical power to lift, push or resist force
example_en: Weight training helps athletes increase their strength safely.
example_zh: 负重训练能帮助运动员安全地增强力量。
subject: PHE

definition_en: Defensive move to stop an opponent or take possession of the ball
example_en: The defender made a clean tackle to win the ball back.
example_zh: 那名防守队员一记干净的铲抢，把球夺了回来。
subject: PHE

definition_en: Motorized walking/running machine for cardio training
example_en: When it rains, I run on the treadmill at the gym instead of going outside.
example_zh: 下雨的时候，我就在健身房的跑步机上跑步，而不去户外。
subject: PHE

definition_en: Rule violation of illegal movement while holding the ball
example_en: The referee whistled a travel after the player took three steps without dribbling.
example_zh: 那名球员未运球走了三步，裁判吹罚了走步违例。
subject: PHE

definition_en: Quick shift between defense and offense during play
example_en: A fast transition from defense to offense caught the other team off guard.
example_zh: 快速的攻防转换打了对方一个措手不及。
subject: PHE

definition_en: Volleyball player who positions the ball for attackers to spike
example_en: The setter delivered a perfect ball for the outside hitter to spike.
example_zh: 二传手传出一个完美的球，供主攻手扣杀。
subject: PHE

definition_en: Process where digested nutrients pass into the bloodstream or body cells
example_en: Absorption of nutrients mainly takes place in the small intestine.
example_zh: 营养物质的吸收主要发生在小肠中。
subject: Science

definition_en: Chemical reaction where small alkene molecules join to form large polymers
example_en: Polyethene is produced by the addition polymerization of ethene molecules.
example_zh: 聚乙烯是通过乙烯分子的加成聚合反应制得的。
subject: Science

definition_en: Reaction where atoms/groups add across a carbon-carbon double bond
example_en: Ethene undergoes an addition reaction with bromine, turning the orange solution colourless.
example_zh: 乙烯与溴发生加成反应，使橙色溶液褪色。
subject: Science

definition_en: Organic compounds containing one or more hydroxyl functional groups
example_en: Alcohols such as ethanol can be used as fuels and solvents.
example_zh: 乙醇等醇类可用作燃料和溶剂。
subject: Science

definition_en: Saturated hydrocarbons with only single covalent bonds between carbon atoms
example_en: Methane and ethane are alkanes, so they are generally unreactive.
example_zh: 甲烷和乙烷都是烷烃，因此它们通常不太活泼。
subject: Science

definition_en: Unsaturated hydrocarbons containing at least one carbon-carbon double bond
example_en: Alkenes decolourise bromine water because they contain a carbon-carbon double bond.
example_zh: 烯烃含有碳碳双键，因此能使溴水褪色。
subject: Science

definition_en: Tiny air sacs in the lungs where gas exchange takes place
example_en: Oxygen diffuses across the thin walls of the alveoli into the blood.
example_zh: 氧气穿过肺泡薄薄的壁扩散进入血液。
subject: Science

definition_en: Radioactive decay releasing an alpha particle (helium nucleus)
example_en: During alpha decay, the nucleus loses two protons and two neutrons.
example_zh: 在α衰变过程中，原子核失去两个质子和两个中子。
subject: Science

definition_en: Thick-walled blood vessel that carries oxygenated blood away from the heart
example_en: The aorta is the largest artery in the human body.
example_zh: 主动脉是人体中最大的动脉。
subject: Science

definition_en: Upper chamber of the heart that receives incoming blood
example_en: Deoxygenated blood enters the right atrium before flowing into the ventricle.
example_zh: 缺氧血先进入右心房，然后流入心室。
subject: Science

definition_en: Radioactive decay where a neutron converts to a proton, emitting an electron
example_en: In beta decay, the atomic number of the nucleus increases by one.
example_zh: 在β衰变中，原子核的原子序数增加一。
subject: Science

definition_en: Energy required to separate protons and neutrons within an atomic nucleus
example_en: A nucleus with a high binding energy per nucleon is very stable.
example_zh: 每个核子结合能高的原子核非常稳定。
subject: Science

definition_en: Hydrocarbon structure with side carbon chains attached to the main chain
example_en: 2-methylpropane is a branched chain isomer of butane.
example_zh: 2-甲基丙烷是丁烷的一种支链同分异构体。
subject: Science

definition_en: Major airway that branches from the trachea into each lung
example_en: Each bronchus carries air from the trachea into one lung.
example_zh: 每条支气管把空气从气管输送到一侧肺中。
subject: Science

definition_en: Microscopic blood vessel where gas, nutrient and waste exchange occurs
example_en: Capillary walls are only one cell thick to allow efficient diffusion.
example_zh: 毛细血管壁仅由一层细胞构成，以实现高效扩散。
subject: Science

definition_en: Functional group (–COOH) found in carboxylic acids
example_en: The carboxyl group gives carboxylic acids their acidic properties.
example_zh: 羧基赋予羧酸酸性。
subject: Science

definition_en: Organic acid containing a carboxyl group; ethanoic acid is a common example
example_en: Vinegar contains ethanoic acid, a weak carboxylic acid.
example_zh: 食醋中含有乙酸，这是一种弱羧酸。
subject: Science

definition_en: Substance that speeds up a chemical reaction without being consumed
example_en: Iron is used as a catalyst in the Haber process to make ammonia.
example_zh: 在哈伯法合成氨的过程中，铁被用作催化剂。
subject: Science

definition_en: Self-sustaining nuclear or chemical reaction where each reaction triggers further reactions
example_en: In a nuclear reactor, the chain reaction is controlled to release energy steadily.
example_zh: 在核反应堆中，链式反应受到控制，以平稳地释放能量。
subject: Science

definition_en: Stomach muscle contractions that mix food with digestive juices
example_en: The stomach churns food into a semi-liquid mixture called chyme.
example_zh: 胃通过蠕动搅拌把食物变成一种半流质混合物，称为食糜。
subject: Science

definition_en: Natural 24-hour biological cycle governing sleep, hormones and activity
example_en: Circadian rhythms tell our bodies when to sleep and when to wake up.
example_zh: 昼夜节律告诉我们的身体何时入睡、何时醒来。
subject: Science

definition_en: Chemical reaction between a substance and oxygen, releasing heat and light
example_en: The burning of methane is a combustion reaction that releases energy.
example_zh: 甲烷的燃烧是一种释放能量的燃烧反应。
subject: Science

definition_en: Combustion with plentiful oxygen, producing carbon dioxide and water
example_en: During complete combustion of propane, only carbon dioxide and water are formed.
example_zh: 丙烷完全燃烧时，只生成二氧化碳和水。
subject: Science

definition_en: Reaction where two molecules join together with the loss of a small molecule (e.g. water)
example_en: Condensation joins amino acids together to form proteins, releasing water.
example_zh: 缩合反应将氨基酸连接起来形成蛋白质，同时脱去水分子。
subject: Science

definition_en: Arteries that supply oxygen and nutrients to the heart muscle
example_en: Blocked coronary arteries can lead to a heart attack.
example_zh: 冠状动脉堵塞可能导致心脏病发作。
subject: Science

definition_en: Molecule formed by atoms sharing electron pairs
example_en: Water is a covalent molecule made of two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.
example_zh: 水是由两个氢原子和一个氧原子构成的共价分子。
subject: Science

definition_en: Alkanes with carbon atoms arranged in a closed ring structure
example_en: Cyclohexane is one of the cyclic alkanes found in crude oil.
example_zh: 环己烷是原油中存在的环烷烃之一。
subject: Science

definition_en: Spontaneous breakdown of an unstable atomic nucleus
example_en: The radioactive decay of carbon-14 is used to date ancient remains.
example_zh: 碳-14的放射性衰变被用于测定古代遗物的年代。
subject: Science

definition_en: Metabolic disorder causing abnormal blood glucose regulation
example_en: People with diabetes must monitor their blood glucose levels carefully.
example_zh: 糖尿病患者必须密切监测自己的血糖水平。
subject: Science

definition_en: Dome-shaped muscle that controls inhalation and exhalation
example_en: When the diaphragm contracts and flattens, air is drawn into the lungs.
example_zh: 膈肌收缩变平时，空气被吸入肺部。
subject: Science

definition_en: Passive movement of particles from an area of high concentration to low concentration
example_en: Oxygen enters the blood by diffusion across the alveoli.
example_zh: 氧气通过扩散穿过肺泡进入血液。
subject: Science

definition_en: Separation technique using differences in boiling points to purify liquids
example_en: Distillation can be used to obtain pure water from seawater.
example_zh: 蒸馏可用于从海水中获得纯净水。
subject: Science

definition_en: Release of particles or radiation from an unstable atomic nucleus
example_en: The emission of gamma rays often accompanies alpha or beta decay.
example_zh: 伽马射线的放出常伴随α衰变或β衰变发生。
subject: Science

definition_en: Biological catalyst that speeds up chemical reactions inside living organisms
example_en: Amylase is an enzyme that breaks down starch into sugars.
example_zh: 淀粉酶是一种能把淀粉分解成糖的酶。
subject: Science

definition_en: Organic compound formed from carboxylic acid and alcohol
example_en: Ethyl ethanoate is an ester with a sweet, fruity smell.
example_zh: 乙酸乙酯是一种带有甜果香味的酯。
subject: Science

definition_en: Condensation reaction between a carboxylic acid and alcohol to form an ester
example_en: Esterification of ethanoic acid with ethanol produces ethyl ethanoate and water.
example_zh: 乙酸与乙醇发生酯化反应，生成乙酸乙酯和水。
subject: Science

definition_en: Muscular tube that transports food from the mouth to the stomach
example_en: Peristalsis pushes food down the esophagus into the stomach.
example_zh: 蠕动把食物沿食道推入胃中。
subject: Science

definition_en: Highly reactive atom or molecule with an unpaired electron
example_en: Free radicals can damage cells, but antioxidants help neutralise them.
example_zh: 自由基会损伤细胞，但抗氧化剂有助于将其清除。
subject: Science

definition_en: Nuclear reaction splitting a large unstable nucleus into smaller nuclei
example_en: Nuclear power stations generate electricity from the energy released by fission.
example_zh: 核电站利用裂变释放的能量发电。
subject: Science

definition_en: Nuclear reaction combining small nuclei into a larger nucleus, releasing massive energy
example_en: The Sun produces energy through fusion, where hydrogen nuclei combine to form helium.
example_zh: 太阳通过核聚变产生能量，氢原子核结合形成氦。
subject: Science

definition_en: Radioactive emission of high-energy electromagnetic radiation
example_en: After alpha decay, an excited nucleus releases its excess energy through gamma decay.
example_zh: 原子核在α衰变后处于激发态，会通过γ衰变释放多余的能量。
subject: Science

definition_en: Organ that produces and secretes hormones or other chemical substances
example_en: The pancreas is a gland that secretes insulin into the bloodstream.
example_zh: 胰腺是一种能向血液中分泌胰岛素的腺体。
subject: Science

definition_en: Simplified formula representing an entire family of organic compounds
example_en: All alkanes can be represented by the general formula CnH2n+2.
example_zh: 所有烷烃都可以用通式 CnH2n+2 来表示。
subject: Science

definition_en: Hormone that raises blood glucose levels by breaking down glycogen
example_en: When blood sugar is low, the pancreas releases glucagon to raise glucose levels.
example_zh: 当血糖偏低时，胰腺会释放胰高血糖素来升高血糖水平。
subject: Science

definition_en: Compact storage form of glucose in liver and muscle cells
example_en: Muscles store glucose as glycogen so it can be used quickly during exercise.
example_zh: 肌肉将葡萄糖以糖原的形式储存，以便在运动时快速利用。
subject: Science

definition_en: Time taken for half of a radioactive sample to undergo decay
example_en: The half-life of carbon-14 is about 5,730 years, so it is used to date ancient remains.
example_zh: 碳-14 的半衰期约为 5730 年，因此可用于测定古代遗物的年代。
subject: Science

definition_en: Body’s ability to maintain stable internal conditions despite external changes
example_en: Sweating helps the body maintain homeostasis by cooling it down on hot days.
example_zh: 天热时出汗能给身体降温，帮助维持体内稳态。
subject: Science

definition_en: Chemical messenger carried in blood to regulate bodily functions
example_en: Insulin is a hormone that controls the amount of glucose in the blood.
example_zh: 胰岛素是一种控制血液中葡萄糖含量的激素。
subject: Science

definition_en: Organic compound composed only of hydrogen and carbon atoms
example_en: Methane is the simplest hydrocarbon, made of one carbon atom and four hydrogen atoms.
example_zh: 甲烷是最简单的烃，由一个碳原子和四个氢原子构成。
subject: Science

definition_en: Functional group (–OH) characteristic of alcohols
example_en: Every alcohol molecule contains a hydroxyl group (–OH) attached to a carbon atom.
example_zh: 每个醇分子都含有一个连接在碳原子上的羟基（–OH）。
subject: Science

definition_en: Brain region that controls homeostasis, hormone release and circadian rhythms
example_en: The hypothalamus helps regulate body temperature, hunger and sleep cycles.
example_zh: 下丘脑帮助调节体温、饥饿感和睡眠周期。
subject: Science

definition_en: Combustion with limited oxygen, producing carbon monoxide or soot
example_en: Burning gas in a poorly ventilated room causes incomplete combustion and produces toxic carbon monoxide.
example_zh: 在通风不良的房间里燃烧燃气会引起不完全燃烧，产生有毒的一氧化碳。
subject: Science

definition_en: The process of taking food into the digestive system
example_en: Ingestion begins when food enters the mouth and is chewed.
example_zh: 摄食从食物进入口腔并被咀嚼时开始。
subject: Science

definition_en: Hormone that lowers blood glucose by promoting glucose uptake into cells
example_en: People with diabetes may need insulin injections to keep their blood sugar under control.
example_zh: 糖尿病患者可能需要注射胰岛素来控制血糖。
subject: Science

definition_en: Long digestive organ where most nutrient digestion and absorption occurs
example_en: Digested food passes into the intestines, where most nutrients are absorbed into the blood.
example_zh: 消化后的食物进入肠道，大多数营养物质在那里被吸收进入血液。
subject: Science

definition_en: Atoms of the same element with equal protons but different numbers of neutrons
example_en: Carbon-12 and carbon-14 are isotopes because they have the same number of protons but different neutrons.
example_zh: 碳-12 和碳-14 是同位素，因为它们的质子数相同而中子数不同。
subject: Science

definition_en: Hormone produced to regulate sleep-wake cycles and circadian rhythms
example_en: The body releases melatonin at night to help you feel sleepy.
example_zh: 人体在夜间释放褪黑素，让人产生睡意。
subject: Science

definition_en: Reaction between an acid and a base to form salt and water
example_en: Adding lime to acidic soil is a common example of neutralization in farming.
example_zh: 向酸性土壤中加入石灰是农业中常见的中和反应实例。
subject: Science

definition_en: Neutral subatomic particle located inside the atomic nucleus
example_en: A neutron carries no electric charge and is found in the nucleus of an atom.
example_zh: 中子不带电荷，存在于原子核内。
subject: Science

definition_en: Strong fundamental force that holds nucleons together in a nucleus
example_en: The nuclear force binds protons and neutrons together inside the tiny nucleus.
example_zh: 核力将质子和中子紧紧地束缚在微小的原子核内。
subject: Science

definition_en: Process that alters the structure or composition of an atomic nucleus
example_en: Fission and fusion are two types of nuclear reaction that release enormous energy.
example_zh: 核裂变和核聚变是两种能释放巨大能量的核反应。
subject: Science

definition_en: State where a nucleus has no tendency to undergo radioactive decay
example_en: Isotopes with an imbalanced neutron-to-proton ratio lack nuclear stability and tend to decay.
example_zh: 中子与质子比例失衡的同位素缺乏核稳定性，容易发生衰变。
subject: Science

definition_en: Central core of an atom containing protons and neutrons
example_en: The nuclei of radioactive atoms can decay and emit radiation.
example_zh: 放射性原子的原子核会发生衰变并释放辐射。
subject: Science

definition_en: Substance required by organisms for energy, growth and maintenance
example_en: Plants absorb nutrients such as nitrates from the soil through their roots.
example_zh: 植物通过根部从土壤中吸收硝酸盐等营养物质。
subject: Science

definition_en: Compound containing carbon, typically bonded with hydrogen
example_en: Ethanol is an organic compound found in alcoholic drinks and some fuels.
example_zh: 乙醇是一种存在于酒类饮品和某些燃料中的有机化合物。
subject: Science

definition_en: Net movement of water across a semipermeable membrane
example_en: Water enters plant roots from the soil by osmosis.
example_zh: 水通过渗透作用从土壤进入植物根部。
subject: Science

definition_en: Chemical reaction involving loss of electrons or gain of oxygen
example_en: The rusting of iron is a slow oxidation reaction with oxygen and water.
example_zh: 铁生锈是铁与氧气和水发生的缓慢氧化反应。
subject: Science

definition_en: Substance that causes oxidation by accepting electrons
example_en: Oxygen acts as an oxidizing agent when magnesium burns brightly in air.
example_zh: 镁在空气中剧烈燃烧时，氧气充当氧化剂。
subject: Science

definition_en: Gland that produces digestive enzymes and blood sugar regulating hormones
example_en: The pancreas produces enzymes that help digest fats and proteins in the small intestine.
example_zh: 胰腺产生的酶能在小肠中帮助消化脂肪和蛋白质。
subject: Science

definition_en: Wave-like muscle contractions that push food along the digestive tract
example_en: Peristalsis pushes food from the oesophagus down into the stomach.
example_zh: 蠕动将食物从食道推入胃中。
subject: Science

definition_en: Plant tissue that transports dissolved sugars and organic nutrients
example_en: The phloem carries sugars made in the leaves to the growing parts of the plant.
example_zh: 韧皮部把叶片制造的糖分运输到植物的生长部位。
subject: Science

definition_en: “Master gland” that regulates other endocrine glands and hormone production
example_en: The pituitary gland releases growth hormone, especially during puberty.
example_zh: 垂体释放生长激素，在青春期尤为活跃。
subject: Science

definition_en: Small cell fragments responsible for blood clotting
example_en: Platelets gather at a cut to form a clot and stop the bleeding.
example_zh: 血小板聚集在伤口处形成血凝块，从而止住出血。
subject: Science

definition_en: Large long-chain molecule made from many repeated small monomer units
example_en: Poly(ethene) is a polymer made by joining thousands of ethene monomers.
example_zh: 聚乙烯是由成千上万个乙烯单体连接而成的聚合物。
subject: Science

definition_en: Positively charged subatomic particle inside the atomic nucleus
example_en: Each proton carries a positive charge and has a relative mass of 1.
example_zh: 每个质子带一个单位正电荷，相对质量为 1。
subject: Science

definition_en: Spontaneous emission of radiation from unstable atomic nuclei
example_en: Marie Curie won two Nobel Prizes for her pioneering research on radioactivity.
example_zh: 居里夫人因在放射性方面的开创性研究而两次获得诺贝尔奖。
subject: Science

definition_en: Laboratory technique to heat a mixture while preventing liquid evaporation loss
example_en: Heating under reflux lets the reaction mixture boil without losing any solvent.
example_zh: 加热回流能使反应混合物沸腾而不损失溶剂。
subject: Science

definition_en: Mathematical constant used to calculate radioactive decay rates
example_en: Scientists use the reproduction constant k to predict how quickly a radioactive sample will decay.
example_zh: 科学家利用增殖常数 k 来预测放射性样品的衰变速度。
subject: Science

definition_en: Energy inherent to all matter as described by mass-energy equivalence
example_en: According to Einstein's equation E=mc², even an object at rest contains an enormous amount of rest energy.
example_zh: 根据爱因斯坦的方程 E=mc²，即使静止的物体也蕴含着巨大的静能。
subject: Science

definition_en: Hydrocarbon with only single carbon-carbon bonds; no double or triple bonds
example_en: Methane and ethane are examples of saturated hydrocarbons because their carbon atoms are joined only by single bonds.
example_zh: 甲烷和乙烷是饱和烃的例子，因为它们的碳原子之间只以单键相连。
subject: Science

definition_en: Biological faculty that detects and responds to external environmental stimuli
example_en: The sense of smell helps animals detect food and danger in their environment.
example_zh: 嗅觉帮助动物察觉环境中的食物和危险。
subject: Science

definition_en: Device used to measure lung volume and breathing capacity
example_en: In the biology lab, students used a spirometer to measure how much air their lungs could hold.
example_zh: 在生物实验课上，学生们用肺量计测量自己的肺能容纳多少空气。
subject: Science

definition_en: Random nature of radioactive decay; decay of individual atoms cannot be predicted
example_en: Radioactive decay is a statistical process, so we can only predict the behaviour of a large number of atoms, not a single atom.
example_zh: 放射性衰变是一个统计过程，因此我们只能预测大量原子的行为，而无法预测单个原子。
subject: Science

definition_en: Hydrocarbon structure with carbon atoms forming a single continuous line
example_en: Butane is a straight chain alkane made of four carbon atoms linked in a row.
example_zh: 丁烷是一种直链烷烃，由四个碳原子依次排成一行相连而成。
subject: Science

definition_en: Tiny pores on plant leaves for gas exchange and water vapour release
example_en: On hot days, plants close their stomata to reduce water loss from their leaves.
example_zh: 在炎热的日子里，植物会关闭气孔以减少叶片水分的散失。
subject: Science

chinese: 结构异构体（同分异构体）
definition_en: Compounds with the same molecular formula but different structural arrangements
example_en: Butane and 2-methylpropane are structural isomers because they share the formula C₄H₁₀ but have different structures.
example_zh: 正丁烷和2-甲基丙烷互为结构异构体，因为它们分子式都是 C₄H₁₀，但结构不同。
subject: Science

definition_en: Organic reaction where one atom or group is replaced by another
example_en: When methane reacts with chlorine in sunlight, a substitution reaction replaces a hydrogen atom with a chlorine atom.
example_zh: 甲烷在光照下与氯气反应时，会发生取代反应，一个氢原子被氯原子取代。
subject: Science

chinese: 碳-14 测年法（放射性碳定年法）
definition_en: Radiocarbon dating method using carbon-14 to age organic materials
example_en: Archaeologists used ¹⁴C dating to estimate that the wooden tool was about 3,000 years old.
example_zh: 考古学家利用碳-14 测年法估计这件木制工具约有 3000 年的历史。
subject: Science

definition_en: Water loss from plant leaves through stomata
example_en: Transpiration helps pull water up from the roots to the leaves of a tall tree.
example_zh: 蒸腾作用有助于把水分从根部向上拉到大树的叶片。
subject: Science

definition_en: Directional growth response of a plant to an external stimulus
example_en: Phototropism is a type of tropism in which a plant grows towards light.
example_zh: 向光性是一种向性，指植物朝着光源方向生长。
subject: Science

definition_en: Hydrocarbon containing one or more carbon-carbon double or triple bonds
example_en: Ethene is an unsaturated hydrocarbon because it contains a carbon-carbon double bond.
example_zh: 乙烯是一种不饱和烃，因为它含有碳碳双键。
subject: Science

definition_en: Flap-like structure that prevents the backflow of blood in veins and the heart
example_en: Valves in the heart make sure that blood flows in only one direction.
example_zh: 心脏中的瓣膜确保血液只朝一个方向流动。
subject: Science

definition_en: Blood vessel that carries deoxygenated blood back toward the heart
example_en: The vena cava is the largest vein in the human body, returning blood to the heart.
example_zh: 腔静脉是人体最大的静脉，负责把血液送回心脏。
subject: Science

definition_en: The process of moving air into and out of the lungs (breathing)
example_en: During exercise, the rate of ventilation increases to supply more oxygen to the muscles.
example_zh: 运动时，通气速率会加快，以便为肌肉提供更多氧气。
subject: Science

definition_en: Lower heart chamber that pumps blood out to the lungs or body
example_en: The left ventricle has thick muscular walls to pump blood around the whole body.
example_zh: 左心室壁肌肉厚实，能把血液泵送到全身。
subject: Science

definition_en: Small finger-like projections in intestines that increase absorption surface area
example_en: Villi in the small intestine absorb digested nutrients into the bloodstream.
example_zh: 小肠中的绒毛把消化后的营养物质吸收进血液。
subject: Science

definition_en: Plant tissue that transports water and dissolved minerals upward from roots
example_en: Water absorbed by the roots travels up the stem through the xylem vessels.
example_zh: 根部吸收的水分通过木质部导管沿茎向上运输。
subject: Science

definition_en: Common carboxylic acid (acetic acid), main component of vinegar
example_en: Ethanoic acid gives vinegar its sour taste and can react with ethanol to form an ester.
example_zh: 乙酸使醋具有酸味，并能与乙醇反应生成酯。
subject: Science
